URL correctly built from request scheme+host (preview URL); expires_at ~30 days. hit_count increments on second fetch. (2) BIFF preset-late-handoff → Claude refine → risk='Escalation Flag' → copy-tone-safe-btn appends new milestone {source:'biff_kudos', type:'success', title:'Coach kept a hot message tone-safe'} both in localStorage 'sacoparents_milestone_logs' AND visible in milestone-history-list. critical_code_review_comments: SacoparentsPortal.jsx now 2205 lines — well past the 700-line guideline. Extracting TrendSparkline (already at module scope) is a good pattern; suggest also extracting BiffTab, AlignmentHub, and ShareControls into their own files for maintainability.
createShareLink's error branch swallows the underlying error (bare `catch {}`). Adding a console.warn(exc) would make production debugging easier without leaking to users.

portal_routes._regenerate_share_pdf runs on every /share POST as a smoke test — cheap for foundation/legal but generates a full weekly PDF (multi-KB) that gets discarded. Consider a lightweight `_validate_share_payload` per artefact type instead of a full build.

The share endpoint has no auth; anyone with a link can regenerate the PDF for 30 days. That is by design per the docstring ('treat like a share-token, not a secret'), but for privacy-sensitive legal reports we might want an optional passphrase or a shorter TTL toggle in a follow-up.
seed_data_creation: None — resets parent1 portal state via PUT /api/portal/state at test start.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Share URLs are built from the request host — on the preview cluster they resolve to https://prepared-parents.preview.emergentagent.com, NOT sacoparentsapp.online. The 410-expired test manipulates the portal_pdf_shares doc directly via motor; MONGO_URL/DB_NAME must be exported into the shell before running pytest (`set -a; . backend/.env; . frontend/.env; set +a`). Clipboard writes need context.grant_permissions(['clipboard-read','clipboard-write']). Dialog handler must be attached BEFORE any click that fires alert() — the Tone-Safe and Share buttons both raise alert dialogs.
